channel.title: The Grant Desk - weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Alpaca Festival 2027: Open Call for Pattern-Based Performances, Workshops and Talks (Sheffield, UK)
item.description: Pattern Club (Alpaca Festival) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Performances: artist fee plus national travel expenses. Workshops: artist fee, materials expenses and national travel expenses. Fee amounts are not yet confirmed (tight budget); additional costs may be covered on request. International travel is not covered beyond a small European train budget. Conference talks: no fee or expenses, in-person speakers get a free festival weekend pass and lunch on 6 and 7 May. No application fee.

item.title: American-Scandinavian Foundation: Fellowships for Americans in the Nordic Countries 2027-28
item.description: American-Scandinavian Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Long-term fellowships of up to USD 23,000 for 4 to 12 months; short-term grants of up to USD 5,000 for 1 to 3 months. In 2026, 31 American Fellows received over USD 277,390 in total funding. Awards are given in all fields, including creative arts projects.

item.description: Stroom Den Haag · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project, up to EUR 20,000 per applicant per calendar year. item.title: Netherlands Film Production Incentive: High-End Series (October 2026 round)
item.description: Netherlands Film Fund (Nederlands Filmfonds) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Cash rebate of up to 35 percent of qualifying Dutch production costs, capped at EUR 3 million per project per year per applicant production company.
